description: User-created model variants exposed edit and delete as icon-only buttons without accessible names.
expected: Each variant action should be named with the target variant, such as `Edit UX Walker Temp Variant` and `Delete UX Walker Temp Variant`.
actual: After creating a variant, the action controls appeared as unlabeled buttons in the interactive tree.
suggested_fix: Add per-variant aria-labels to the edit and delete icon buttons.
